hotelWelcome.sub-text-welcome: Welcome to The Tailor Hotel, nestled on Nahalat Binyamin — one of Tel Aviv’s most vibrant and iconic streets. Our hotel offers a contemporary hospitality experience, thoughtfully designed and tailored to suit guests from Israel and around the world. Just like a tailor who crafts each garment with precision and care, we draw inspiration from the local spirit to create a stay that’s personal, stylish, and meticulously curated down to the last detail.

homeRooms.roomsText: The Tailor Hotel offers a unique hospitality experience with 29 beautifully designed rooms, including 2 luxurious suites. Each room is thoughtfully crafted, blending style, comfort, and functionality with precision. Many rooms overlook a vibrant urban landscape and offer breathtaking views of the Mediterranean Sea. All accommodations are equipped with top-tier modern amenities to ensure a comfortable, enelant, and truly unforgettable stay.
homeRooms.roomsSideNote: Check‑in is available from <1>15:00</1>. Check‑out is until <3>12:00</3>.
homeRooms.roomsSideNoteCancellationPolicy: The Tailor Hotel’s cancellation policy allows changes up to 48 hours prior to arrival.

roomCardEconomy.subTitle: Economy Room
roomCardEconomy.description: Intimate, cozy, and tastefully designed. The Economy Room is ideal for guests seeking a calm hideaway in the heart of the city, with refined décor, a comfortable double bed, and a warm Tel Aviv atmosphere.

roomCardStandard.subTitle: Standard Room
roomCardStandard.description: A refined, comfortable room with a plush double bed and a calm space to unwind after a lively day in the city. Perfect for couples or solo travelers seeking a balance of comfort, location, and atmosphere.

roomCardSuperior.subTitle: Superior Room
roomCardSuperior.description: A stylishly designed room with refined furnishings and a modern bathroom. Enjoy a calm, comfortable stay in the heart of the city, complete with thoughtful touches that make all the difference.

roomCardSuperiorBalcony.subTitle: Superior Room with Balcony
roomCardSuperiorBalcony.description: All the comfort of a Superior room, plus a private balcony overlooking the vibrant, colorful Nahalat Binyamin boulevard. Perfect for guests who enjoy both the room and the city atmosphere.

roomCardDeluxe.subTitle: Deluxe Room
roomCardDeluxe.description: Spacious, elegant, and inviting with a refined boutique feel. The Deluxe room features curated furnishings, a cozy seating area, and a stylish bathroom—offering comfort and calm right in the heart of the city.

roomCardDeluxeBalcony.subTitle: Deluxe Room with Balcony
roomCardDeluxeBalcony.description: A room that blends calm with a charming urban view. The Deluxe Balcony offers generous space, refined design, and a private terrace overlooking the colorful, lively streets of Nahalat Binyamin.

roomCardSuite.subTitle: Suite with Balcony
roomCardSuite.description: Bright suites on the upper floors with a spacious balcony overlooking the Mediterranean and lively Nahalat Binyamin. Ideal for couples seeking a boutique experience.

homeMap.sub-text-map: The Taylor is located on Nahalat Binyamin, one of Tel Aviv’s most vibrant and iconic streets, once known as a hub for textiles, markets, and local craftsmanship. Just a few steps from the colorful Carmel Market and surrounded by a rich variety of restaurants, bars, and beloved cafés, you’ll enjoy a lively urban atmosphere around the clock — right outside your door.

Accessibility.introText: The Tailor Hotel is committed to ensuring an accessible experience for all guests and website users. Our facilities comply with accessibility standards, and our website follows WCAG 2.2 guidelines to support users of all abilities.

sections.title: Website Accessibility
items: Our website follows WCAG 2.2 accessibility guidelines to ensure content is perceivable, operable, understandable, and robust for all users.
We have implemented an Accessibility Widget that allows you to adjust font sizes, color contrast, text spacing, and link highlighting according to your needs.
All interactive elements on the website are keyboard-accessible and screen-reader friendly.

sections.title: Accessible Rooms
items: The hotel offers 2 fully accessible rooms for guests using wheelchairs or requiring additional support.
Accessible rooms are equipped with wider doorways, roll-in showers, and grab bars for safety.
Staff is available to assist guests with mobility needs upon request.

sections.title: Public Areas
items: All public areas, including lobby, restaurant, and corridors, are designed to be wide enough for wheelchair access.
Stairs are equipped with anti-slip strips and tactile indicators (metal circles) at the start for visually impaired guests.
Elevators and ramps are provided where necessary to ensure smooth access to all floors.

sections.title: Accessible Toilets
items: The hotel provides accessible public toilets designed for guests with mobility challenges.
Facilities include grab bars, sufficient turning space for wheelchairs, and accessible sinks.

sections.title: Ongoing Commitment
sections.paragraph: The Tailor Hotel continuously monitors and improves accessibility standards both on the website and in the physical premises to ensure a safe, inclusive, and welcoming experience for all guests.

sections.title: Contact for Accessibility Assistance
sections.paragraph: For any questions or special requests regarding accessibility, please contact our staff at hello@thetailortlv.com. We are happy to assist you in planning a comfortable stay.

privacyPage.introText: This Privacy Policy explains how The Tailor Hotel collects, uses, and protects your personal information, in compliance with applicable data protection laws, including the GDPR.

sections.title: General
sections.paragraph: The Tailor Hotel website values your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your data in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the GDPR.

sections.title: Data Collection
items: We collect data to improve website performance and user experience.
Information may include non-personal usage data and technical information such as visited pages or general interaction patterns.
We use analytics and marketing tools such as Google Analytics 4 and Meta Pixel only after you provide explicit consent.
No sensitive personal data is collected without explicit consent.

sections.title: Cookies and Tracking Technologies
items: We use cookies and similar technologies to ensure proper website functionality and performance.
Analytics and marketing cookies are only activated after you provide consent via the cookie consent banner.
If you do not provide consent, no analytics or marketing events are collected or processed.
You can manage or withdraw your consent at any time through your browser settings or by clearing stored cookies or local storage.

sections.title: Analytics and Marketing Services
items: Google Analytics 4 is used to understand how visitors interact with the website and to improve its content and performance.
Meta (Facebook) Pixel is used to measure the effectiveness of advertising campaigns and understand user interactions.
Both Google Analytics and Meta Pixel are only activated after explicit user consent.
If consent is not provided, no tracking or marketing events are sent to these services.

sections.title: Use of Collected Data
items: Data is used to improve website functionality, performance, and content.
Analytics data helps us understand aggregated website traffic and usage trends.
Marketing data, when consent is provided, may be used to optimize advertising campaigns.
Data is not sold and will only be shared with third parties when required by law or for services such as analytics, advertising, or hosting.

sections.title: User Rights under GDPR
items: You have the right to access, correct, or delete personal data collected about you.
You may request restrictions on or object to the processing of your personal data.
You can withdraw your consent for analytics or marketing processing at any time.
You have the right to lodge a complaint with a relevant data protection authority.

sections.title: Data Retention
sections.paragraph: We retain personal and non-personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Privacy Policy, comply with legal obligations, or resolve disputes.

sections.title: Third-Party Services
items: We may use third-party services such as Google Analytics and Meta Pixel for analytics and marketing purposes.
These services may process data outside the European Union in accordance with their own privacy policies.
Where required, appropriate safeguards such as standard contractual clauses are applied to protect user data.

sections.title: Security Measures
items: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect collected data.
Access to personal data is restricted to authorized personnel only.
Data is transmitted securely using HTTPS and other reasonable security measures.

sections.title: Policy Updates
sections.paragraph: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, legal requirements, or services. Any updates will be published on this page.

sections.title: Contact Information
sections.paragraph: For any questions, concerns, or requests regarding your personal data, please contact us at hello@thetailortlv.com or through the contact form on our website.
